title: Glycolysis Stress Test for Monocyte Glycolytic Function
author: Brandt D Pence
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ufaetie
materials: Aspirate Cell-Tak solution if not already done.
While plate is incubating, perform steps 9-13

steps.title: Warm Analyzer and Hydrate Cartridge
steps.instruction: Turn on the Seahorse XFp analyzer to warm up overnight; add 200 µl XF calibration solution to each well of the sensor cartridge, add 400 µl sterile PBS or H₂O to each moat, and incubate the cartridge overnight at 37 °C in a non‑CO₂ incubator.

steps.title: Prepare Media and Cell‑Tak Coating
steps.instruction: Make Seahorse DMEM assay medium and coat the XFp plate with Cell‑Tak.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µl pyruvate and 50 µl L‑glutamine to 5 ml Seahorse Base Medium; sterile‑filter the mixture.

Prepare Cell‑Tak solution: mix Cell‑Tak with sodium hydroxide in 0.1 M sodium bicarbonate so that each well will receive 0.56 µg Cell‑Tak and a final NaOH concentration of 0.63 mM (batch‑specific calculations may be required).
Add 25 µl Cell‑Tak solution to each well of the XFp plate.
Incubate the plate at room temperature for at least 20 min (or pre‑coat earlier, aspirate excess, air‑dry, and store at 4 °C until use).

steps.title: Prepare Monocyte Suspension
steps.instruction: Dilute isolated monocytes to 3 × 10⁶ cells ml⁻¹ in the prepared Seahorse DMEM medium and keep the suspension on ice for immediate use.

steps.title: Prepare Drug Dilutions
steps.instruction: Create preliminary stock dilutions, then dilute to the final working concentrations required for the assay.

substeps.instruction: ‑ 100 mM glucose (blue cap): add 300 µl medium.
‑ 50 µM oligomycin (light‑blue cap): add 288 µl medium.
‑ 500 mM 2‑deoxyglucose (green cap): add 300 µl medium; vortex 1 min.
‑ 10 µM oligomycin: combine 120 µl of 50 µM oligomycin stock with 480 µl medium.

steps.title: Seed Cells and Medium
steps.instruction: Add cells and medium to the assay plate.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µl assay medium to wells A and H.
Add 50 µl cell suspension (1.5 × 10⁵ cells per well) to wells B‑G; run samples in duplicate or triplicate as desired.

steps.title: Centrifuge Plate
steps.instruction: Place the plate in the carrier and centrifuge at 300 × g for 1 min without brake.

steps.title: Add Assay Medium
steps.instruction: Add 130 µl assay medium to each well (wells A‑H) to bring the final well volume to 180 µl.

steps.title: Incubate Plate
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at 37 °C in a non‑CO₂ incubator for 1 hour.

steps.title: Prepare Sensor Cartridge
steps.instruction: Remove the sensor cartridge from the incubator and briefly remove and re‑insert the sensors to clear air bubbles.

steps.title: Load Injection Ports
steps.instruction: Fill the cartridge injection ports with the appropriate reagents.

substeps.instruction: Port A (all wells): add 20 µl glucose to achieve a final concentration of 10 mM.
Port B (all wells): add 22 µl oligomycin for a final concentration of 1 µM.
Port C (all wells): add 25 µl oligomycin for a final concentration of 2 µM (used when two oligomycin injections are desired).
Port D (all wells): add 27 µl 2‑deoxyglucose to achieve a final concentration of 50 mM.

steps.title: Program XFp for Assay
steps.instruction: Select the Glycolysis Stress Test program on the Seahorse XFp, calibrate the sensor cartridge (remove lid), and if using two oligomycin injections, load a custom program.

steps.title: Transfer Plate and Start Run
steps.instruction: After the 1‑hour cell incubation, remove the utility plate from the XFp, insert the cell plate (remove lid), and start the assay.

steps.title: Acquire Assay Measurements
steps.instruction: Run the assay, recording three measurements per injection (including the basal measurement).

steps.title: Post‑Assay Imaging or Collection
steps.instruction: After the run, image each well by photomicroscopy or collect/isolate protein from each well for cell‑number normalization.
